targets.purpose: Make the ladder from pattern to organization to integration to individuality explicit.
targets.requiredConcept: A useful higher-level description is not by itself evidence of a higher-order individual.

targets.purpose: Strengthen evolutionary individuality as the biological precedent for the question.
targets.requiredConcept: Cooperation is insufficient; conflict suppression, specialization, dependency, reproduction and selection-level questions matter.

targets.requiredText: SIGNAL ≠ INFORMATION ≠ INTEGRATION ≠ INTELLIGENCE ≠ AGENCY ≠ CONSCIOUSNESS

targets.area: Early civilization discussion, before final model comparison
targets.purpose: Introduce the null/ordinary-complex-organization explanation early enough to compete throughout the argument.
targets.requiredConcept: Billions of organisms may construct highly integrated systems without producing an additional individual.

targets.purpose: Replace some repetitive disclaimers with progressively stronger scientific discrimination rules.
targets.requiredText: Resemblance generates hypotheses. Mechanism generates evidence. Prediction separates models.

targets.purpose: Turn reader from audience into adversarial investigator.
targets.requiredConcept: Assume the hypothesis is wrong; ask what would make it lose and what would discriminate it from the simpler rival model.
